villagerbargains.config.title: Villager Bargains
villagerbargains.config.note: Applies to trades a villager unlocks from now on. Trades it already offers keep their price; demand follows the new mode from the villager's next restock.
villagerbargains.pricing.minimum.descrip: Every random price (books and enchanted gear) is the cheapest vanilla can roll, and demand never raises prices.
villagerbargains.pricing.normal.descript: Vanilla behaviour: random prices and the vanilla demand rule.
villagerbargains.pricing.maximum.descrip: Every random price (books and enchanted gear) is the most expensive vanilla can roll, and every trade is priced as if sold out.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.villagerb: Pins villager and wandering trader prices to the cheapest (or most expensive) value vanilla can produce: random prices of enchanted books and gear, and the demand surcharge. Enchantments, reputation discounts and Hero of the Village stay vanilla.
